/* Roles used by the statute */

  md_8_401_secretary_may_adopt_regulations(+Secretary)
  Citation: MD SPP  8-401 (2021) ("Subject to the approval of the Governor, the Secretary may adopt regulations ...")
*/
md_8_401_secretary_may_adopt_regulations(Secretary) :-
    md_actor(Secretary, secretary),
    md_8_401_governor_approved(adopt_regulations_under_8_401),
    !.

/* Governor approval is a prerequisite in  8-401; we encode it as a fact that may or may not hold. */

/*
  md_8_401_payment_requires_payroll_authorization(+Officer, +Employee, +Amount, +Services)
  Citation: MD SPP  8-401(1)(i)-(iii)
*/
md_8_401_payment_requires_payroll_authorization(Officer, Employee, Amount, Services) :-
    payroll_authorization(secretary_of_budget_and_management, Officer, Employee, Amount, Services),
    !.

/*
  md_8_401_payment_requires_principal_unit_head_certification(+PrincipalUnit, +PayPeriod, +Employee)
  Citation: MD SPP  8-401(2)
*/
md_8_401_payment_requires_principal_unit_head_certification(PrincipalUnit, PayPeriod, Employee) :-
    principal_unit_head(Head, PrincipalUnit),
    payroll_certification(Head, PrincipalUnit, PayPeriod, Employee),
    !.

/*
  md_8_401_officer_may_pay_wages(+Officer, +Employee, +Amount, +Services, +PrincipalUnit, +PayPeriod)
  Citation: MD SPP  8-401 (overall rule: officer may not pay unless both (1) authorization and (2) certification)
*/
md_8_401_officer_may_pay_wages(Officer, Employee, Amount, Services, PrincipalUnit, PayPeriod) :-
    md_8_401_payment_requires_payroll_authorization(Officer, Employee, Amount, Services),
    md_8_401_payment_requires_principal_unit_head_certification(PrincipalUnit, PayPeriod, Employee),
    !.

/* --- Data predicates that the statute rule could consult (none are provided by the question) --- */
principal_unit_head(_Head, _PrincipalUnit) :- fail.
payroll_authorization(_Secretary, _Officer, _Employee, _Amount, _Services) :- fail.
payroll_certification(_Head, _PrincipalUnit, _PayPeriod, _Employee) :- fail.
